text: 中国财政部发行63天期债券，规模200亿元，发行利率1.0316%，边际利率1.0913%，预期1.0400%，投标倍数3.58倍，边际倍数1.14倍； 中国财政部发行182天期债券，规模550亿元，发行利率1.1233%，边际利率1.1700%，预期1.1500%，投标倍数3.10倍，边际倍数16.74倍； 中国财政部发行10年期债券，规模800亿元，发行利率1.6057%，边际利率1.6159%，预期1.6200%，投标倍数6.21倍，边际倍数1.44倍。
text_en: China's Ministry of Finance issued 63-day bonds totaling 20 billion yuan, with an issuance rate of 1.0316%, a marginal rate of 1.0913%, an expected rate of 1.0400%, a bid-to-cover ratio of 3.58 times, and a marginal bid-to-cover ratio of 1.14 times; China's Ministry of Finance issued 182-day bonds totaling 55 billion yuan, with an issuance rate of 1.1233%, a marginal rate of 1.1700%, an expected rate of 1.1500%, a bid-to-cover ratio of 3.10 times, and a marginal bid-to-cover ratio of 16.74 times; China's Ministry of Finance issued 10-year bonds totaling 80 billion yuan, with an issuance rate of 1.6057%, a marginal rate of 1.6159%, an expected rate of 1.6200%, a bid-to-cover ratio of 6.21 times, and a marginal bid-to-cover ratio of 1.44 times.
